title: 아마존 삼림벌채 역대 최저 수준 — 브라질 INPE 위성 데이터
snippet: Brazil's INPE reports Amazon deforestation at 1,325 km² for Aug 2025 - Jan 2026, on pace for the lowest on record since at least 2014. However, a separate study (Phys.org/Apr 2026) finds that while deforestation policies successfully reduced clearing, they failed to stop forest degradation — areas experiencing selective logging, fire damage, and fragmentation continue to expand. NDVI time-series from Landsat-8/9 confirm divergent trends between deforestation and degradation.
tag_reason: 아마존 삼림벌채 최저 기록은 이전 미보고 신규 이벤트. INPE 공식 위성 데이터(DETER/PRODES) 기반. 산림 황폐화(degradation) 연구와 결합하여 이중 서사 구성.

entities.name: INPE (Brazil National Institute for Space Research)
